data: Which line in the top right plot has the highest value at the point where the x-axis is 10^3?

The top right plot shows three lines representing different methods: CorEx (blue), Sparse CorEx (purple), and LDA (red). To determine which line has the highest value at the point where the x-axis is \(10^3\), I will compare the y-values of these lines at this specific x-value.

At \(x = 10^3\):
- The blue line (CorEx) appears to have the highest y-value among the three lines.
- The purple line (Sparse CorEx) is below the blue line.
- The red line (LDA) is also below the blue line.

Thus, the blue line (CorEx) has the highest value at the point where the x-axis is \(10^3\).
